verdict.rationale: Kong documents latency-related tooling (usage analytics and OTel metrics that track LLM request latency and upstream processing time, semantic caching, load balancing across models) which implies attention to performance, but there is no explicit claim or benchmark quantifying the gateway's own added latency overhead as 'minimal'. missing for 10: quantified latency-overhead benchmarks, independent performance tests, explicit vendor claim of low proxy overhead.
